blocks.text: Among the shown award options, I’d choose the business-cabin itinerary arriving earlier in Bangkok: it has the shortest reported elapsed time of these two complete award choices. The tradeoff is a substantial Turkish Airlines points requirement, an added separately ticketed SFO–LAX flight, and unverified award-seat and fee details. No cabin preference was specified, so the economy option is worth considering if using fewer points matters more than arriving earlier.

Departs SFO at 8:36 a.m. on January 8 and arrives in Bangkok at 4:15 a.m. on January 10 (local times). The award portion is reported as business class on Turkish Airlines from LAX via Istanbul to Bangkok, for 275,000 Turkish-program points; its reported cabin does not establish the cabin of each leg. There is a 2-hour-20-minute Istanbul connection. The separate American Airlines positioning flight reaches LAX at 10:15 a.m., leaving a 2-hour-30-minute gap before the award departure at 12:45 p.m. Those are separate tickets, and protection or bookability across them is unverified. Award-seat support and taxes/fees are not reliably reported.

blocks.text: Compared with the economy choice below, this business option arrives 4 hours 35 minutes earlier and has 4 hours 20 minutes less elapsed travel time. Those are arrival and elapsed-time differences, respectively.
